title: AI Multi-Agent Orchestrator
codeSnippet:
class AgentOrchestrator:
    def __init__(self, rag_engine, tools):
        self.rag = rag_engine
        self.tools = tools
        self.agents = [ResearchAgent(), CodeAgent(), QAAgent()]
    
    async def execute_task(self, prompt: str) -> ExecutionResult:
        # 1. Retrieve domain context via Vector RAG
        context = await self.rag.retrieve_top_k(prompt, k=5)
        # 2. Plan and delegate to specialized subagents
        plan = await self.agents[0].create_plan(prompt, context)
        return await self.dispatch_parallel(plan)
desc: Autonomous multi-agent orchestration framework featuring Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), intelligent subagent delegation, dynamic tool execution, and automated QA pipelines.

title: Media Lakehouse & ETL Platform
codeSnippet:
with DAG(dag_id="media_medallion_pipeline", schedule="@daily", catchup=False) as dag:
    # Bronze: Raw Ingestion via Distributed Scraper
    scrape_raw = PythonOperator(task_id="scrape_news_bronze", python_callable=scrape)
    # Silver: Cleansed & Normalized Delta Parquet
    clean_silver = SparkSubmitOperator(task_id="transform_silver", conn_id="spark")
    # Gold: Aggregated Analytics Warehouse
    load_gold = PostgresOperator(task_id="aggregate_gold_warehouse", sql="load.sql")
    scrape_raw >> clean_silver >> load_gold
desc: Distributed Big Data platform for ingesting, transforming, and visualizing media news articles using a Medallion Lakehouse architecture (Bronze, Silver, Gold layers) with Airflow scheduling.

title: Global-NewsStream-Enterprise-Lakehouse-Real-Time-Media-Intelligence-Platform
codeSnippet:
from airflow import DAG
from airflow.operators.bash import BashOperator
from datetime import datetime

with DAG(
    dag_id='news_stream_pipeline',
    start_date=datetime(2023, 1, 1),
    schedule_interval='@daily',
    catchup=False,
    tags=['news', 'lakehouse', 'elt'],
) as dag:
    ingest_raw_data = BashOperator(
        task_id='ingest_raw_news',
        bash_command='python /app/scrapers/run_scraper.py',
    )
    process_to_bronze = BashOperator(
        task_id='process_to_bronze_layer',
        bash_command='spark-submit /app/pipelines/bronze_processor.py',
    )
    ingest_raw_data >> process_to_bronze
desc: This platform provides a comprehensive, distributed solution for real-time media intelligence by ingesting, processing, and visualizing news article data from various sources. It leverages a robust enterprise lakehouse architecture, implementing ETL/ELT processes and real-time streaming to deliver scalable and insightful media analytics.
features: Implemented a distributed Enterprise Lakehouse architecture (Medallion Zone) for scalable data storage and processing.
Engineered real-time data ingestion and streaming pipelines using Apache Kafka for high-throughput news article processing.
Orchestrated complex ETL/ELT workflows with Apache Airflow, automating data transformation from raw to curated layers.
Integrated comprehensive monitoring (Prometheus, Grafana) and interactive data visualization (Apache Superset) for media intelligence.
